status_of_claims: three measured SYMPTOMS; only the TC CLS->z degradation is tightly component-localized. See `overstatements_withdrawn`.

protocol.primary_metric: safe-action choice on the 36 DEV roots offering both a fatal and a safe action
protocol.EXPLORATORY: the objective and head were selected on the same 36-root DEV panel the headline is reported on. Grouped inner-TRAIN selection and an untouched confirmation panel are in phase 4; until those land these are exploratory.
protocol.patch_cache_dtype: float16 for patches/pooled taps; z and cls are float32

symptom_1_readout_objective.conclusion: a large part of the reported deficit was decision-objective mismatch in the MEASUREMENT. BCE and ranking test different capabilities; this does not make the BCE numbers meaningless.

symptom_2_export_degradation.tightly_localized: TC loses most of its signal between CLS (33.0) and z (21.0). That is the one component-exact localization in this package.
symptom_2_export_degradation.raw_is_gentler: raw declines patches 36.0 -> cls 31.3 -> z 29.7, spread across the path
symptom_2_export_degradation.width_claim_scope: 192 post-hoc dimensions suffice ON THIS PANEL. This does NOT show an end-to-end trained 192-d latent has adequate capacity.

symptom_3_generated_state_utility.conclusion: generated LeWM states show no demonstrated incremental safe-death ordering beyond the root/history+action control. Direct's do.

u_world_negative_result.provenance: artifacts/lewm_gates_20260918/m03_matched -- UNSEALED diagnostic. Its arms are NOT Raw/TC: 'raw' is world_z_z and 'tc' is world_u_u, both on one frozen consecutive-TC encoder with MSE-only worlds. Its 'u' is TRAIN-fitted PCA-192 of the 4x4 pooled patch grid.
u_world_negative_result.role: DIAGNOSTIC for Raw/TC, not a canonical architecture
u_world_negative_result.conclusion: observed u is perfectly readable (36/36) while generated u does not beat its control (23.0 vs 24.3). Replacing z with this existing pooled/PCA export does not by itself solve the gate. It does NOT rule out every patch-derived world: frozen TC encoder, one pooled representation, MSE-only, one seed, no joint adaptation, no propagated token grid.

overstatements_withdrawn: 'spatial layout is the missing representation' -- WITHDRAWN. patch_mean discards token position and still reaches 34.7 (raw) / 32.7 (tc), so these data do not support a spatial arrangement requirement. The supported claim is narrower: final patch-token outputs carry a readable signal the learned CLS/projector export does not preserve equally.

'the sequence mixer is exonerated' -- WITHDRAWN for this package. The Transformer arms were never run through the rank/dynamics/derangement ladder; the prior exoneration came from a different protocol.

'health is not the explanation' -- WITHDRAWN. Direct's poor scalar health R^2 does not settle it: a representation can encode the dead/alive boundary sharply while regressing magnitude poorly. Binary health, HUD-crop and masked-HUD controls are required.

'the predictor is not action-conditional' -- SOFTENED. It is architecturally action-conditioned. The evidence says its output adds no demonstrated safe-death ordering; generated u does lose 23.0 -> 15.0 under derangement, so it is not action-blind.
'192 dimensions rule out capacity' -- SCOPED to post-hoc representation width on this panel.
'three separable causes' -- restated as three SYMPTOMS.
not_established: that SIGReg or joint training CAUSED the export degradation
which stage of the predictor fails: pair/action projection, Mamba blocks, prediction projector, or the loss. The ladder stops at final h and generated output.
anything about multistep rollout, achievements or closed-loop control

confirmation_panel.note: C2_export is not evaluated here: the historical shards publish z only, no patch taps, so the export contrast cannot be scored on this panel without re-encoding it.

C1_objective.claim: within-root ranking beats six-target BCE on real Mamba Raw z

C2_export.claim: a pooled-patch PCA-192 rung beats z at matched width on real successors

C3_generated.claim: generated Mamba Raw z beats its own root+action control

CONFIRMED: SYMPTOM 1 (readout objective) CONFIRMED on an untouched 100-root historical panel: real z rank 93.0 vs bce 74.7, paired episode-cluster intervals exclude zero for all three seeds (+0.16/+0.22/+0.17).
SYMPTOM 2 (export) confirmed on DEV with paired intervals excluding zero for all seeds (+0.176). NOT testable on the confirmation panel: historical shards publish z only, no patch taps.
SYMPTOM 3 (generated utility) CONFIRMED on the untouched panel: generated z 51.3 vs root+action 55.7; no seed's interval excludes zero in the favourable direction.
phase4_corrections_to_my_own_claims: MY SINGLE-DRAW DERANGEMENT WAS NOISE. Over 20 draws mamba_raw scores 14.0 intact vs 17.9 deranged (cost -3.9): its generated successors carry NO usable action information, and my reported 'cost 0.0' was one lucky draw. Ordering: mamba_raw -3.9 < mamba_tc 0.95 < world_u_u 2.8 < transformer_raw 7.2 < direct 16.05.

THE SEQUENCE MIXER IS NOT EXONERATED AND NOT NEUTRAL. The Transformer predictor is substantially MORE action-conditional than Mamba's (7.2 vs -3.9) -- but its intact score (22.0) still only matches its own root+action control (21.3). Action-conditioning improved; decision utility did not.

HEALTH IS LARGELY THE EXPLANATION, and my dismissal was wrong. HUD patch tokens alone give a PERFECT dead/alive AUC (1.0000 raw, 0.9992 tc) and 36/36 safe choice, while z gives 0.765/0.718. The patch advantage over CLS is substantially a retained HUD health readout. Map-only tokens still reach 0.833 and 34.7, so it is not exclusively HUD.

SCOPE: this panel is 34/36 terminal-tail with root health 1-2, so the decision largely reduces to 'which action takes health to zero'. The finding may not transfer to decisions that are not health-threshold decisions.

indicated_next_intervention.not_an_export_change: u->u already trained on a spatial export; generated u 23.0 vs control 24.3
indicated_next_intervention.not_a_backend_swap: the Transformer improves action-conditioning 7.2 vs -3.9 without improving decision utility over its control
indicated_next_intervention.the_open_question: why action-conditional generated states still fail to beat root+action. Candidates the ladder did NOT separate: the MSE objective favouring predictable persistent coordinates, the pair/action projection, successive Mamba blocks, the prediction projector, training horizon. The ladder stops at final h and generated output.
indicated_next_intervention.cheapest_next: instrument the predictor internals on the EXISTING u world -- pair/action projection, per-block state, prediction-projector stages -- since real u is 36/36 and generated u is 23.0 on one lineage, which brackets the loss tightly.

phase5_predictor_internals.method: forward hooks on the gate's own 17-action branch fan: pair_projection, every Mamba block, final_norm (h), each predictor_projector stage, and generated z. Parity asserted: the hooked generated z reproduces the published tensor exactly (max_abs 0.0 both arms).
phase5_predictor_internals.ANSWER: The action's influence does not die at a stage -- the consequence is never constructed. For mamba_raw NO tap exceeds its root+action control (19.0) at any depth: every stage sits at 14-21 with a NEGATIVE action cost, from the first pair_projection onward. For mamba_tc the pair_projection alone is marginally above control (26.0, cost +2.62) and that margin is eroded monotonically with depth to 18.0 at the output. Two different internal profiles, the same endpoint.
phase5_predictor_internals.secondary: the final 192-d output projection is additionally lossy: mamba_raw 19.0 (GELU) -> 14.0 (final Linear), a 5-point drop at the last layer, replicated as the worst tap of the path.
phase5_predictor_internals.consequence_for_repair: this is NOT a 'where did it get lost' problem with a stage to fix. The predictor passes a representation of (root, action) through and never computes the successor consequence that distinguishes the fatal branch. Deepening, widening or re-exporting does not address that; the training signal that would require it does.

MASKED_REENCODE_causal_HUD_test.why: phase 4 subset final ViT tokens by original patch position. Those are post-self-attention and may carry whole-image information, so they cannot establish that HUD PIXELS matter.
MASKED_REENCODE_causal_HUD_test.result: re-encoding ACTUAL masked images CONFIRMS the HUD reading causally and more strongly: HUD-only pixels give 36.0/36 at AUC 1.000 for both cls and patch_mean, while map-only (HUD zeroed) collapses to 23-25/36 at AUC 0.53-0.59. On this panel the decision is almost entirely 'read the health bar'.

U_WORLD_INTERNALS.encoder_trap: matched_10k's ENCODER is paired_window/RAW, which is the variant=tc, centering=consecutive arm. My first two attempts failed parity (53.9, 52.5) until the hash was asserted against the state cache.
U_WORLD_INTERNALS.ANSWER: Weak THROUGHOUT, established at the input projection, neither amplified nor destroyed by depth. AUC holds .79-.84 from pair_projection to generated_u; the final projection costs only .019. So the u world does NOT discard the consequence at export. The frozen-head permutation costs ~.30 AUC at EVERY stage including the output, so its generated states DO carry real action-specific structure. But real u scores AUC .9998 with a frozen cost of .609 -- roughly double. The world retains about half the action-conditional structure and ~.20 AUC less, already at the first projection.

why_wrong: phase 5's own AUC column contradicted it: mamba_raw within-root AUC RISES through the blocks .750 -> .812, above its root+action control's .794. The stack does construct some ordering.
mamba_tc holds ~.83 through the entire stack and then collapses at the final 2048->192 linear (.815 -> .664) -- a localized output-projection problem, not an absence.
phase 5 used ONE probe seed, 36 exploratory roots, no paired intervals, no frozen-head permutation, and never instrumented the u world it called the cheapest next experiment.
the frozen-head test in phase 6 shows the u world carries ~.30 AUC of action structure at every stage, so a refit-based null was not evidence of absence.
RETRACTED_phase5_headline.corrected: There is no single stage where top-1 capability catastrophically disappears. Raw gains average ordering through its blocks without reliable action choice; TC retains ordering internally and loses much of it at the final latent projection; the u world is uniformly weak from the input projection onward while remaining genuinely action-conditional.

SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.question: is Direct trained on the same corpus as the LeWM arms?
SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.answer: YES, the same corpus -- but the TRAINING TARGET differs, and that is the suspect.

corpus.lewm: joint runs train on artifacts/craftax_support_v2 (recorded dataset contract a87ae28635e111fc...)
corpus.direct: artifacts/eda/replay.py pins STORE = artifacts/craftax_support_v2; cache_actionable_roots.py imports it and emits 'all 17 successor frames under the original key'. Its latent_cache_64 records 8,325 episodes (a subset).

the_actual_difference.direct: artifacts/eda/run_v2_phase2.py trains the world with counterfactual=sampler(pack,...) and prints 'roots x 17 counterfactual targets/step'. encode_broad_forks.py:88 builds z_branch = encode_last(... for a in range(N_ACTIONS)) -- the successor for EVERY action from the SAME root. Direct is explicitly supervised on same-state action contrast.
the_actual_difference.lewm: d4mj/lewm.py joint_loss: prediction = world.teacher(pairs, actions).predicted with the LOGGED actions, target pairs[:, 1:] -- the actual next latent. ONE action per state, the factual one. It has never seen two different actions from the same state.
the_actual_difference.consequence: the gate asks exactly the counterfactual question Direct was trained on and LeWM never was

explains: Direct beats its root+action control -- it was trained for precisely that discrimination
all four LeWM arms fail to -- they share the factual-only objective
the sequence backend barely matters (Mamba vs Transformer): this is not architectural
the richer u export does not help: input richness cannot create counterfactual supervision
phase 5/6 internals are flat and weak from the pair projection onward -- nothing ever trained them to separate branches from a shared root
TC's CLS->z export damage is a SEPARATE, additive problem, not this one
SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.second_difference_worth_noting: Direct's encoder was trained with RECONSTRUCTION losses -- its training_report curve records mse and lpips, and its config carries mae_p_max/lpips_weight. A reconstruction objective must preserve HUD pixels; SIGReg has no such pressure. That independently explains the phase-6 HUD result.
SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.status: STRUCTURAL EXPLANATION, NOT YET AN EXPERIMENT. It is read from the training code, not demonstrated by a controlled run.
SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.decisive_test: one matched frozen-encoder LeWM arm trained WITH counterfactual branch targets against an otherwise identical arm trained WITHOUT -- same encoder, sampler, optimizer, schedule, updates and seed. Everything else in this ladder is consistent with the hypothesis but cannot discriminate it from the alternatives.
SUSPECT_training_target_not_corpus.prior_art_in_this_project: matches 'Terminal supervision verdict -- broad hazard-choice sampling is the fix' and 'Craftax corpus audit -- consequence density and exposure are the deficits'
